field.description: Dotted path of the offending input field, e.g. `lines.2.quantity`. Null for failures not tied to a field.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code. A code never changes meaning once published, so clients may branch on it rather than on the message text.

details.description: Field-level or check-level detail. Always present, an empty array when there is nothing to add.

message.description: Human-readable and safe to display verbatim. Never contains a stack trace, file path, query, hostname, or credential.

requestId.description: Identifier for this request, identical to the x-request-id response header, so a user-visible failure can be traced to the server record that explains it.

checks.description: Each dependency reported separately, so a failure can be attributed.
